issues.description: Interface name mismatch for the milk-related capability: the problem statement and UML expect an interface named 'Milkable' with method signature String messageOnMilk(), and the template's Main.java refers to 'Milkable' (used in the milkables array). In the solution repository the interface is named 'Dairy' (Dairy.java declares messageOnMilk()) and Seal.java and Goat.java implement 'Dairy'. Additionally, solution's Milkable.java is effectively empty. This inconsistent naming (Milkable vs Dairy) breaks the one-to-one mapping students expect between the UML/problem text and the provided solution code and will confuse which interface students should implement or use.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the interface name consistent across all artifacts. Replace the solution's 'Dairy' interface with 'Milkable' (i.e., rename Dairy.java to Milkable.java or move the messageOnMilk() declaration into Milkable.java) and update Seal.java and Goat.java to implement Milkable. Remove or populate the empty Milkable.java in the solution so there is a single 'Milkable' interface matching the problem statement and template. This preserves the pedagogy while removing confusion.
